reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(t.order_eur) AS value_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.channel
alternatives: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS value_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.channel
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS value_eur FROM sales GROUP BY channel

solver.query:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur
FROM order_values
GROUP BY channel
